header.title:
Skip the sales reps.
Talk directly to the builders.
header.subtitle: No gatekeepers. No annoying forms asking for your annual revenue or your mother's maiden name. Just lay out the biggest bottleneck in your current setup, and we'll tell you honestly if our tools are the right fit.

directLine.title: The Direct Line
paragraphs: Email me directly at founders@weblings.com. I don't employ an offshore support desk or a team of quota-driven sales reps.
When you email this address, you get direct access to the engineers actually writing the code. I check this inbox twice a day, and I will personally write you back.
guarantees: You will always talk to a real human, never a chatbot.
Absolutely zero pressure—we aren't here to upsell you.
Honest advice: if our platform isn't the perfect fit, we will tell you upfront.

form.title: Tell us what is driving your team crazy.
